interpretation.title: Breakthrough
interpretation.summary: The piece begins in total darkness and silence. Faint particles of light slowly gather and organize, energy builds steadily, and the accumulated light finally breaks through in a single peak before settling into a lit afterglow.
understood: The arc is a long, patient build.
The peak is a breakthrough of light.
There is no explicit request about how it ends.

phases.name: Total Dark
phases.note: Near-black stage, no visible form; a held stillness.

phases.name: First Motes
phases.note: Sparse, dim particles appear and drift; a low drone barely surfaces.

phases.name: Gathering
phases.note: Particles converge into a slowly tightening ring; brightness and sound swell together.

phases.name: Pressure
phases.note: Light strains against a dense lattice; a steady pulse adds tension.

phases.name: Breakthrough
phases.note: The lattice breaks and warm light floods the stage; no strobing, a single sustained bloom.

phases.name: Afterglow
phases.note: A calm, lit monolith remains; sound settles into a warm drone.

constraints.text: Open in total darkness before any light appears.

interpretation.strategy: Withhold light almost entirely, let it accumulate with patient, convergent geometry, then hold the tension briefly before releasing one warm, sustained bloom.
